USS Pelion: Frontier · ship tokens

Outlines of every ship in the game, at 1 inch and ¾ inch. Print at 100% (no scaling), cut along the circles, and point the bow the way the ship is heading. Colour them in by power if you like: gold for the Pelion, blue for Starfleet support, red for the Klingons, green for the Romulans, orange for the Orions.
